items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: Oh that's a relation to me too. Well he's related. I didn't know that's right. That's right. Yeah. There's a little four cousins but they're related.

ctx.x: Can you tell us anything else about your uncle while I think of it, Clay Giles? Somehow we hear more about him I think than, of course your father died so young. Was your uncle Clay probably the best one of the brothers at Drum then or what would you say?

Well, he was after my father died. But my father, not saying it because it's my father, but I don't know much but what I heard. James can tell you, Joe Gabriel, they played with him. So he was one of the outstanding drummers. He's great. He was a great drummer and he was also a comedian. He had played with shows. And he would get up from the drum and he'd get on the stage.

items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Oh, yeah, the Deuce, you know him, the bass player? James? ... Yeah, he used to play the tenor saxophone.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, the Deuce, you know him, the bass player? James?
Yeah, he used to play the tenor saxophone.
